name: @peer2peer/ext-ix
description: The Ix extension for Peer2Peer v3: share Ix session notes, subgraph references and blast-radius reports between agent sessions (x:ix.note, x:ix.subgraph, x:ix.impact), and flag semantic conflicts. Needs only a local Ix install. (bundled copy shipped with the Claude Code mod; built by packages/ext-ix/scripts/bundle.mjs)
